headline: MOGUL v11.6 — zodiac + tarot + psychic affinity
summary: Gender + birth month added to character creation. Birth month drives a zodiac sign with an industry affinity — a passive +5% income bonus in that field (business / engineering / medicine / science / arts). Pre-game suggestion combines zodiac + historical era. Spirit tab gains an opt-in tarot draw with 22 major-arcana cards (30-day cooldown, cryptic hint per draw). The character-creation screen now matches the design image: name, gender, birth year + month, country, religion, interests, talents.
features: Gender: male / female / nonbinary (cosmetic; random picks any of 3)
Birth month 1-12 → zodiac sign (Capricorn ... Pisces) with industry affinity
12 zodiac signs, each with symbol, trait, blurb, affinity field (5 arts / 3 business / 2 engineering / 2 medicine / 0 science)
zodiacAffinityMult: +5% income in the affinity field (wired into bizMultiplier, socialIncome, jobIncome)
Pre-game suggestion: combines zodiac affinity + historical era (translated en/vi/zh) shown on Intro review step
Zodiac preview box in Intro: shows sign symbol, trait, blurb, affinity
Tarot panel in Spirit tab: opt-in toggle, draw button (30-day cooldown), 22 major-arcana cards, recent draws log (last 10)
Random character generator now also picks gender + birth month
Character-creation screen now matches the design: name / gender / birth month+year / country / religion / interests / talents
Version bumped to v11.6 on homepage + version.json
